meta.title: Three-Body Universe atlas · plot, cast and live three-body simulation
meta.description: The Three-Body trilogy as an explorable atlas: plot arcs, 56 characters with 247 curated relations, 52 events across 10 eras, 24 technologies, 19 places, 37 glossary terms, 30 quotes, the 9 levels of the in-novel game, 16 adaptation differences and 8 multi-angle themes. It also ships a real simulation lab: a velocity-Verlet gravity integration whose planet radiation flux yields the 恒纪元/乱纪元 calendar, plus a sensitivity measurement, a stability scan, a Dark Forest agent sandbox and a deterrence game. Open it from the sidebar entry ☄️ Three-Body. Eight agent tools (three_body_search / detail / relation / timeline / simulate / theme / game / ask) share the same dataset. Curated by hand; defer to the novels for fine detail.
